newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PSG BEGIN RECOVERY WITH 3-0 FRENCH CUP WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSG BEGIN RECOVERY WITH 3-0 FRENCH CUP WIN.

text.p: Paris Saint-Germain, humiliated by Juventus in the European Super Cup, recovered some of their badly dented pride with a 3-0 French Cup first round win at third division Besancon on Sunday.
PSG went ahead in the eighth minute when Besancon's Gilles Contat scored an own goal from a corner taken by Brazilian Rai.
But they had to wait until the 69th minute to secure the match when striker Cyrille Pouget, newly signed from Servette of Switzerland, scored his first goal for the Parisian club.
France international Patrice Loko, a late substitute for Pouget, added the third eight minutes from time.
PSG's superior fitness told in the end on a frozen pitch that has curtailed Besancon's training in recent weeks.

They also did not make the same mistake as last week when they did not practice in the appropriate boots for icy surfaces and were over-run 6-1 at home by world club champions Juventus in the first leg of the European Super Cup.

Sunday's victory will have boosted PSG's confidence ahead of their top-of-the-table first division clash at Monaco next weekend, the more so in view of the league leaders' French Cup defeat at second division Laval on Friday.
Strasbourg, the only other first division side in action on Sunday, won 4-0 at fourth division Schiltigheim.
The all first division match beween Metz and Montpellier was postponed for the second time in three days.
